2. The Defendant-Respondent-Petitioner Nos.1-9 are the second generation heirs of one Mokdom Ali Sheik and the Plaintiff-Appellant-Opposite party Nos. 1-13 arc the second generation heirs of one Jumu Sheik. The said Mokdom Ali Sheik and Jomu Sheik were the sons of Basharat Sheik. The Plaintiff-Appellant-Opposite parties by filing Partition Suit on 3.2.1999, alleged inter-alia that the landed property within Mouja Surujgonj, under District and Police Station Tangail comprised in C.S. Khatian No. 116 within C.S. Plot No. 171 area 0.52 acres and C.S. plot No. 303 having an area 0.27 acres at a total of 0.79 acres were the Ejmali property of both the brothers Mokdom Ali Sheik and Jumu Sheik for which the plaintiff's being entitled to 0.41 acres of land prayed for separate Saham as the Defendant-Respondent-Opposite parties are possessing more then their entitlement. 

 16. The learned Advocate Mr. Subrata Saha, after appearing before this court argued in the case on behalf of the plaintiff-appellant-opposite parties and while taken this Court through the appellate Judgment vehemently argued that the finding of the Appellate Court cannot be interfered with by this Court since the Appellate Court relief upon the Exhibit-1 which is the information slip revealing that the name of the two brothers has been recorded in S.A. Khatian.
